scope: Read-only audit of the entire support fragment, all eight prerequisite-diagnostic questions/solutions, all six delayed-retention questions/solutions, scoring/remediation/reference/synthesis material, and support_check plus assembly logic. Only this peer-review record was written.

resolved_findings.finding: The initial wording specified independent complete replications but asked for an unbiased sample variance and estimated Monte Carlo standard error without explicitly stating identical law and finite variance. The numbers were correct under the intended fixed simulator law.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root changed the prompt to four iid complete simulation replications from the same fixed simulator law with finite variance and mirrored those assumptions in the solution. Both changes were inspected; --support-only passed afterward.

prerequisite_and_instruction_review: The diagnostic requires only previously taught Volume1 rates/units/compounding, Volume2 projection and Volume3 expectation/mixtures/Bayes/covariance/normal intervals/decision losses. No programming or Volume4-only technique is required before beginning the volume.

Prior chapter routes were inspected against the curriculum, and relevant compounding, covariance/shared-shock and projection prerequisites were read or confirmed. The positive gross-factor convention selects the economically intended half-year root.

Diagnostic scoring is8 times4=32, with a28 threshold and an explicit two-result/two-reasoning-or-units split. Examinations retain five20-point domains, four5-point parts each,180 minutes,85/100 overall and15/20 per domain, with critical-error remediation.
Retention scoring is six10-point tasks. Every prompt/solution allocation sums to10:3+4+3,4+3+3,4+3+2+1,6+2+2,3+2+3+2,3+3+4. The51/60 and7.5/10 rules permit half points explicitly.

Calendar gaps, unknown active reports and stock-versus-flow distinctions are preserved. Projection remains descriptive. Confidence coverage is attached to repeated-sample procedures, and mean uncertainty is distinguished from a future observation.

Frozen-versus-updating forecast evaluation, selecting after final outcomes, round-last versus display subtraction, population estimates versus respondent counts and local hash limits are correctly distinguished.

Remediation asks for changed-input evidence and cause-specific repairs. Oral transfer requires traceability, independent reconstruction, permitted-information reasoning and inference limits; self-recording is not represented as external certification.

Twelve-chapter capability and notation indexes cover the accepted scope. The index distinguishes price-index P from population P and covariance gamma(h) from roundoff gamma_k. The synthesis labels the cross-volume foundation examination as still in production.
